title: OSCC: Certified Observation-Safe Coupling Optimization for Gradient-Noise Control in Imperfect-Information Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.33543v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Coupled rollouts can reduce the noise of counterfactual action comparisons, but two issues prevent standard common-random-number constructions from serving as a general learning primitive in imperfect-information environments. First, an invalid coupling may expose hidden state, synchronize endogenous policy randomness, or misalign chance events after counterfactual histories diverge. Second, in multi-action policy optimization, lower return-contrast variance is not by itself the relevant objective: the optimizer depends on the return covariance matrix after projection through the local policy-gradient geometry. translated_title: OSCC：面向非完美信息学习中梯度噪声控制的认证观测安全耦合优化
translated_abstract: 耦合的轨迹推演可以降低反事实动作比较中的噪声，但存在两个问题阻碍了标准的共同随机数构造在非完美信息环境中作为通用学习原语来使用。首先，无效的耦合可能暴露隐藏状态、同步内生策略随机性，或在反事实历史分叉后错配机会事件。其次，在多动作策略优化中，更低的回报对比方差本身并不是相关的优化目标：优化器实际依赖于经过局部策略梯度几何投影后的回报协方差矩阵。我们提出了观测安全反事实耦合，这是一个通过边际保持、信息状态安全、分支局部策略随机性、语义事件对齐以及先记录后预言机重放等准则来定义可容许耦合类的框架。我们推导了一个梯度感知的耦合准则，表明对于边际保持的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了观测安全反事实耦合（OSCC）框架，通过定义可容许耦合类的多项安全准则并引入梯度感知的耦合优化准则，在非完美信息学习中安全地降低反事实比较噪声，同时针对策略梯度几何控制回报协方差以优化多动作策略。
en_tdlr: OSCC introduces a certified observation-safe counterfactual coupling framework that defines admissible couplings via safety conditions and employs a gradient-aware coupling criterion to reduce counterfactual comparison noise while controlling the return covariance structure for multi-action policy optimization in imperfect-information learning.
